title: SWF: DefineBitsLossless2 encoding for bitmap library items
description: Test that BitmapItem with compressionType='lossless' produces DefineBitsLossless2 (tag 36) in exported SWF. Verify: (1) tag 36 appears when BitmapItem is placed on stage, (2) character ID is unique, (3) tag format field is 3 (32-bit ARGB) for PNG-style data, (4) BitmapItem with compressionType='photo' produces DefineBitsJPEG3 (tag 35) instead.
